title: A local map from a regular local ring sending a regular system of parameters to a regular sequence is flat
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)\subset\mathfrak m_S$). Assume $R$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] of dimension $d$ and $x_1,\dots,x_d\in R$ generate $\mathfrak m_R$ (a regular system of parameters), and that $\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_d)$ is a regular sequence in $S$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]: for each $i$, $\varphi(x_i)$ is a nonzerodivisor on $S/(\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_{i-1}))S$, and $S/(\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_d))S\ne0$. Then $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07DY (lemma-flat-over-regular, line 32694); its proof is a descending induction with the local criterion of flatness (lemma-variant-local-criterion-flatness)

proof.text:
Notation. For $0\le i\le d$ put $R_i=R/(x_1,\dots,x_i)$ and $S_i=S/(\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_i))S$, so $R_0=R$, $S_0=S$. Since $\varphi$ maps $(x_1,\dots,x_i)$ into $(\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_i))S$, it induces a ring map $\varphi_i:R_i	o S_i$. Both rings are quotients of Noetherian local rings by ideals contained in the maximal ideals ($x_j\in\mathfrak m_R$, $\varphi(x_j)\in\mathfrak m_S$); $S_i
e0$ because $S_d
e0$ is a quotient of $S_i$ (the second condition of [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]) and $R_i
eq0$ because it maps to $S_i$. Hence $R_i,S_i$ are Noetherian local rings with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_R/(x_1,\dots,x_i)$, $\mathfrak m_S/(\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_i))S$, and $\varphi_i$ is local. Moreover $S_{i-1}/ ar x_iS_{i-1}=S_i$ and $R_{i-1}/ ar x_iR_{i-1}=R_i$ for $1\le i\le d$, where $ ar x_i$ is the image of $x_i$, acting on $S_{i-1}$ through $\varphi_{i-1}$ as multiplication by the image of $\varphi(x_i)$; so $S_i$ is the $R_i$-module $S_{i-1}/ ar x_iS_{i-1}$.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07DY (lemma-flat-over-regular, line 32694): the rings S/(x_1,...,x_i)S and R/(x_1,...,x_i) of the proof

proof.text: Base case $i=d$. Since $x_1,\dots,x_d$ generate $\mathfrak m_R$, $R_d=R/\mathfrak m_R$ is a field, so the $R_d$-module $S_d$ is flat [lem-weil-pbc-module-over-field-flat]. (For $d=0$ this is already the claim: $\mathfrak m_R=0$, $R=R_0$ is a field and $S$ is flat over it.)

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07DY (lemma-flat-over-regular, line 32694): 'S/(x_1,...,x_d)S is flat over R/(x_1,...,x_d) as the latter is a field'

proof.text: The parameters are nonzerodivisors on the quotients of $R$. Since $R$ is a regular local ring of dimension $d$ and $x_1,\dots,x_d$ generate $\mathfrak m_R$, the sequence $x_1,\dots,x_d$ is a regular sequence in $R$ [lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-generators-regular-sequence]; by the definition of a regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], for each $1\le i\le d$ the image $\bar x_i$ of $x_i$ is a nonzerodivisor on $R_{i-1}=R/(x_1,\dots,x_{i-1})$, and $\bar x_i$ lies in the maximal ideal of $R_{i-1}$. Likewise, by the hypothesis that $\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_d)$ is a regular sequence in $S$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], multiplication by $\bar x_i$ (i.e. by the image of $\varphi(x_i)$) on $S_{i-1}$ is injective. (The Stacks proof uses this nonzerodivisor property on $R/(x_1,\dots,x_{i-1})$ tacitly, in the 'remarks following' Lemma 00ML; it is Lemma 00NQ.)

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07DY (lemma-flat-over-regular, line 32694) ('x_d is a nonzerodivisor in S/(x_1,...,x_{d-1})S'); for R: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00NQ (lemma-regular-ring-CM)

proof.text: Descending induction step. Let $1\le i\le d$ and assume $S_i$ is flat over $R_i$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-criterion-nonzerodivisor] to the local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings $\varphi_{i-1}:R_{i-1}\to S_{i-1}$ (step 1), the finitely generated $S_{i-1}$-module $M=S_{i-1}$ (generated by $1$) and $x=\bar x_i\in\mathfrak m_{R_{i-1}}$, which is a nonzerodivisor on $R_{i-1}$ and on $M$ (step 3); here $M/xM=S_i$ as a module over $R_{i-1}/xR_{i-1}=R_i$ (step 1), which is flat by assumption. Hence $S_{i-1}$ is flat over $R_{i-1}$.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07DY (lemma-flat-over-regular, line 32694): 'hence S/(x_1,...,x_{d-1})S is flat over R/(x_1,...,x_{d-1}) by the local criterion of flatness (see Lemma lemma-variant-local-criterion-flatness [Tag 00ML] and remarks following)'

proof.text: Conclusion. Starting from step 2 ($i=d$) and applying step 4 for $i=d,d-1,\dots,1$ gives that $S_0=S$ is flat over $R_0=R$, i.e. $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
